name: pannello-utilizzo
displayName: Usage Panel – Claude, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, Kimi, GLM and more
description: Side panel with messages, tokens, a daily chart and usage per chat for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Kimi CLI, ZCode (GLM), MiniMax Code, opencode, Kilo Code, Cline, Roo Code, Continue and Aider. Counted locally from their files: no network, no API key.

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.codex.description: Count OpenAI Codex usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.gemini.description: Count Gemini CLI usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.qwen.description: Count Qwen Code usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.kimi.description: Count Kimi CLI usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.zcode.description: Count ZCode (GLM) usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.minimax.description: Count MiniMax Code usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.opencode.description: Count opencode usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.kilo.description: Count Kilo Code usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.cline.description: Count Cline usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.roo.description: Count Roo Code usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.continue.description: Count Continue usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.sources.aider.description: Count Aider usage (reader written from the official source code).

pannelloUtilizzo.folders.markdownDescription: Custom folders per tool, e.g. `{ "codex": "D:/codex-home", "gemini": "~/.gemini", "aider": "C:/work/app1;C:/work/app2" }`. Keys: `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `qwen`, `kimi`, `zcode`, `minimax`, `opencode`, `kilo`, `cline`, `roo`, `continue`, `aider`. Empty = the standard folder of each tool.

pannelloUtilizzo.apiCredits.enabled.description: Show the optional 'API credits' section when its configuration file exists.

pannelloUtilizzo.apiCredits.configFile.description: JSON file with your API credits and prices (written by you, no key). Empty = ~/.claude/utilizzo-api/config.json.

pannelloUtilizzo.refreshSeconds.description: How often to count again while the panel is visible (seconds).

pannelloUtilizzo.language.description: Panel language. 'auto' follows the editor language.
